punchline: Pilecki let himself be caught in a Warsaw roundup so he could build a resistance inside Auschwitz.
thirty_sec: In 1940 the Polish officer Witold Pilecki let a Warsaw roundup catch him and entered Auschwitz as prisoner 4859. He built an underground group and, over seven months, a radio that sent word out of the camp. He escaped in 1943. Mark Manson opens his book on hope with him and asks where hope comes from.
